title: Transition W15: held-out and bounded live-play evaluation (Phase 4)
description:
Workstream W15 of the integrated ADR 0020 transition design, Phase 4 (section
12.4), measured under section 13:
docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md.
That design is the accepted deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed
head afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). ADR 0020 controls.

OWNER
This bead is the single owner of held-out and live-play evaluation of the
rule-discovery experiment. No other bead owns it.

SCOPE
- Author and run HELD-OUT probe variants: probes written after the pipeline was
  tuned and never used to tune it. A held-out probe that was consulted during
  tuning is no longer held out and must be relabelled.
- Then run BOUNDED live play, only after shadow evidence (W9) exists and the
  scripted provider-neutral intervention tests (W10) pass.
- Report M1-M12 with the same instrumentation used offline and in shadow.
- Attribute every miss to the exact stage that lost it - signals, candidates,
  expansion, rule join, dedup, priority, or packet - and convert it into
  successor work for signal extraction, relationship traversal, campaign-rule
  matching, ranking, context retention, capability presentation, or auditor
  policy.

PROHIBITIONS (design sections 3.2, 12.4, 13.2; ADR 0020 section 6)
- A held-out miss bounds an awareness-failure rate on that corpus. It says
  nothing about the corpus's complement. Neither a hit nor a miss establishes or
  refutes universal retrieval completeness, and no result may be reported as if
  it did.
- No aggregate readiness score, completeness score, coverage percentage, or
  universal pass/fail. An aggregate across probes may be reported only as a count
  of probes passing, never as a rate over the rules universe.
- Presence is not use: no measurement infers model reliance from packet
  membership; auditor retries and explicit citations are correlates, never proof.
- No universal clause identity, relationship vocabulary, or corpus-wide
  capability claim.
- No campaign-rule persistence, ruling lifecycle, or discovery-local rule store:
  those remain eshyra-jhpt's.
- No phase is accepted because nothing failed: a stage that recorded no
  candidates, no routes, and no losses has failed to run.

DEPENDENCIES
W10 (context-packet intervention) must be accepted first, which in turn requires
W9 shadow evidence. Not parallel-safe.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE
Held-out probe reports carrying M1-M12 per probe with per-stage attribution of
every miss, an explicit record of which probes were held out and when they were
authored, and bounded live-play reports under the same instrumentation.

REQUIRED NEXT STATE
Held-out probes report M1-M12 with the same instrumentation; misses are
attributed to a named stage and converted into successor work rather than into a
claim about coverage.

MATERIAL CHANGE: no. It measures; it changes no contract, boundary, or runtime
behavior.
acceptance_criteria:
Held-out probe variants are authored after the pipeline was tuned and are
demonstrably not used to tune it; the report records when each was authored and
that it was never consulted during tuning, and any probe that was consulted is
relabelled and excluded from held-out evidence. Bounded live play runs only
after shadow evidence exists (W9) and the scripted provider-neutral intervention
tests pass (W10). M1-M12 are reported per probe with the same instrumentation
used offline and in shadow, and every miss is attributed to the exact stage that
lost it and converted into named successor work. No result claims or refutes
universal retrieval completeness; a held-out miss is reported as bounding an
awareness-failure rate on that corpus only. No aggregate readiness score,
completeness score, coverage percentage, or universal pass/fail is produced;
cross-probe aggregation is reported only as a count of probes passing. No
measurement infers that the model used material because it was present. A stage
that records no candidates, routes, or losses is reported as failed-to-run, not
as passing.

TRACEABILITY: every bead in the W7-W15 set was created 2026-07-31 to execute the
design accepted as the deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed head
afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). They are parented to the ACTIVE
transition epic (eshyra-o9bd.19, or eshyra-olc5 for W13) rather than to the
closed design bead, so lifecycle semantics stay honest; eshyra-o9bd.19.8 remains
the design authority and is referenced from each description.

BOUNDARY THAT MUST NOT ERODE (design sections 8.4 and 14.3): campaign-rule
persistence and ruling lifecycle do not move out of eshyra-jhpt under any of
these items. W11 consumes; it does not own. If the jhpt interface proves
insufficient, the correct response is an amendment or a child under eshyra-jhpt,
never a discovery-local store.
